mentions.name: Wosp
mentions.description: A command-line tool for advanced full-text search of written documents. Called Wosp (word-oriented search and print), it works differently than grep, enabling operations that grep fundamentally cannot, such as proximity searching. First functional version has been released.
mentions.problem: grep fundamentally cannot perform many search operations, such as proximity searching.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a command-line tool for advanced full-text search of written documents.  It works in a completely different way than grep, so it can do a lot of operations that grep fundamentally cannot like proximity searching.

I called it Wosp for word-oriented search and print.  I released the first functional version a few days ago: https://github.com/atrettel/wosp
